segments.name: General Banking Unit
products: commercial and residential real estate construction and mortgage loans
segments.description: A single banking unit providing deposit products and commercial, residential and consumer lending to individuals and companies through its branch offices.
segments.evidence: This single segment is the General Banking Unit.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay interest and fees on loans and leases, depositors pay account fees, and the Bank earns interest and dividends on investments.
revenueModel.evidence: The principal sources of income for the Bank are interest and fees collected on loans and leases, fees collected on deposit accounts and interest and dividends collected on other investments.
